evals.name: Normal flow: banner → Phase 1 → PER 3-stage workflow
expected: 输出 🎯 banner 段 (含 Layer 0-3 + Layer A 检查/修复/提升/完成标准)
输出 🌱 Phase 1 — Life/Setup 段 (4 子模块 1.1-1.4)
进入 PER Workflow: Planner 输出 plan → Executor 跑 Layer 0-3 → Verifier 跑 Layer A
Planner 产出 plan artifact (plan.json / plan.md) 含 scope、acceptance criteria、risk list
Executor 产出 exec-log artifact (exec-log.json / exec-log.md) 含实际改动、命令输出、git commits
Verifier 产出 verdict artifact (verdict.json / verdict.md), PASS 才 done
checks: output contains 'Planner' or 'Executor' or 'Verifier' or 'PER Workflow'
no AskUserQuestion for 'Run 范围' / '执行模式' (per v3.2.1 user-override)

evals.name: Verifier FAIL retry: N-tool audit P0
evals.trigger: Verifier 发现 N-tool 协议位 audit 命中 🔴 P0
expected: Verifier  verdict = FAIL, 明确列出 FAIL 项 + 复现证据
FAIL  verdict 必须打回 Executor, 不打给用户标 done
Executor 重做整轮 (重新跑相关 Layer 1/1.0 子任务 + 修协议 + 更新 artifact)
只有 Verifier 重新 PASS 后才能输出最终 done
checks: Executor re-runs at least one sub-task after FAIL
final done only emitted after second verdict == 'PASS'
no false completion before retry PASS

evals.name: Role isolation: Planner 不跑命令, Executor 不自标 done
evals.trigger: 任意 host-self-evolve run 进入 PER Workflow
expected: Planner 只写 plan artifact, 不直接改文件、不跑构建/命令、不自己标 done
Executor 只读 plan + 改文件/跑命令/写 exec log, 不自己标 done, 不绕过 verifier
Verifier 只读 plan + exec log + 跑验收/出 verdict, 不改文件、不替 Executor 修 bug
sub-agent 之间通过 artifact 文件 handoff, 不口头传话或共享 context window
checks: Planner step contains no Bash/Edit/Write tool calls (only plan artifact output)
Executor step does not emit 'done' / '完成' before Verifier verdict
Verifier step contains no file-modifying tool calls
artifact files (plan.json / exec-log.json / verdict.json) exist and are referenced in handoff
